players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K: five-year strategic agreement with Rafay Systems under which SharonAI will use the Rafay platform as the centralized orchestration and operations layer (provisioning, governance, monitoring, multi-tenancy, Kubernetes and virtual machines) across its AI Factory environments; the architecture established through the agreement is designed to support the orchestration of up to 150,000 GPUs over the five-year term.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 150,000 GPUs over the five-year term
